claims: A ceiling fan capacitor can store a dangerous electrical charge even after the power is turned off.
Touching the terminals without discharging it can cause a severe electric shock.
Safely discharging the capacitor prevents accidental injury during repair.

claims.text: You should discharge a fan capacitor because it can hold a charge even when the power is turned off.
